name: Wand of Embers
description: A slender wand that emits warm, perpetual embers. Grants +1 to fire bolt once per short rest.

name: Cloak of Shadows
description: Draped in shifting darkness. Wearer gains advantage on stealth checks in dim light.

name: Ring of Truth-Telling
description: Simple silver band. Once per day, wearer can force a creature to speak a single truthful sentence.

name: Vorpal Sword
description: A sword that decapitates on a critical hit.

name: Bag of Holding
description: A bag that is bigger on the inside.

name: Potion of Healing
description: A red liquid that heals wounds.

name: Staff of Power
description: A staff of great power.

name: Boots of Speed
description: Boots that double your speed.

name: Amulet of Health
description: Sets your Constitution to 19.

name: Deck of Many Things
description: A deck of cards with wild effects.

name: Holy Avenger
description: A paladin's holy sword.

name: Sphere of Annihilation
description: A sphere of pure void.

name: Hand of Vecna
description: A mummified hand of a lich.

name: Eye of Vecna
description: A mummified eye of a lich.

name: Apparatus of Kwalish
description: A mechanical crab vehicle.

name: Immovable Rod
description: A rod that stays in place when a button is pressed.

name: Lantern of Revealing
description: Reveals invisible creatures.

name: Robe of the Archmagi
description: Powerful robes for a wizard.

name: Shield of the Hidden Lord
description: A shield with a trapped entity.

name: Stone of Good Luck
description: Grants a bonus to ability checks and saving throws.
